phase: Reference Mode Recovery — Aggregate Sectoral Financial Positions
purpose: Test whether ECB QSA supplies a complete quarterly behaviour-over-time reference mode for RMD sector-level financial positions and transactions on the exact represented F2-F8 boundary, while preserving the separate incomplete bilateral Accounting Spine.

source.api: ECB Data Portal SDMX 2.1 REST API

rest_of_world.orientation: X assets = resident external liabilities; X liabilities = resident external assets

construction.resident_component: For each sector-code term, represented assets/liabilities = QSA(F) - QSA(F1), same period/entry/measure.
construction.composite_F: Apply S12 - S121 after constructing boundary-matched values from same-period observations.
construction.X: Construct resident W1 represented assets/liabilities as F-F1; then set X assets = W1 resident liabilities and X liabilities = W1 resident assets.
construction.stock_flow_semantics: Stock and flow are separately published QSA concepts. Flow may not be constructed as a first difference of stock.

consistency_gates.represented_system_net_position_reconcil: For each common stock period, sum H+C+F+G+BNR+X represented net positions must be within 0.1 million RON of zero.
consistency_gates.represented_system_net_transaction_recon: For each common flow period, sum H+C+F+G+BNR+X represented net transactions must be within 0.1 million RON of zero.

promotion_rule: Promote sectoral_financial_positions to OBSERVED_SERIES_AVAILABLE only after a successful immutable live-source artifact is retained, every required sector has finite quarterly stock and transaction outputs on the exact F-minus-F1 boundary for at least the minimum common history and all 2025 quarters, both represented-system reconciliation gates pass in every common period within 0.1 million RON, and a repository snapshot/assessment records artifact identity and hashes. Promotion changes only aggregate reference-mode observability; Accounting Spine readiness, bilateral materialization and behavioural closure remain unchanged.
negative_result_rule: If any required source component, sector, benchmark period, F composite, X orientation or system reconciliation fails, the existing PARTIAL_SERIES_AVAILABLE status remains. No broader BF90 measure, bilateral allocation, missing-to-zero rule or synthetic residual may rescue the gate.
